chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Aʿyan, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
When help descended upon al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, until it was between the heaven and the earth, then he was given the choice of help or the meeting of Allah, so he chose the meeting of Allah.

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ: the heaven, indicating the lofty and manifest nature of the descending help
key_terms.النَّصْرُ: divine help or victory sent in support
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth, paired with heaven to describe the extent of the descent
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ: Imam al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, the central figure of the report
key_terms.فَاخْتَارَ: he chose, indicating deliberate preference and volition
key_terms.لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ: meeting Allah, meaning return to Allah and attaining His presence

ai.seo_question: Why did al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام choose meeting Allah over divine help?
ai.summary: This hadith describes that divine help had descended for al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, yet he was given a choice between victory and meeting Allah. He chose the meeting of Allah, expressing his supreme devotion, sacrifice, and orientation toward the hereafter.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Abdul Malik Bin Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When the helpers descended unto Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> until they were between the sky and the earth, then he<sup>asws</sup> was Given the choice, then help or meeting Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> chose meeting Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from in in a marfu‘ manner from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “. . Then he looked at the stars [37:88] and said, “I am sick!” [37:89]. The Imam (a.s.) said, “He calculated and found what had t happen to al-Husayn (a.s.) then he said, “I am sick for what will happen to al-Husayn (a.s.).”
